payload.recallText: The story was written from childhood memories of the Kennedys who only were 20 miles away. They were Irish and Catholic like the writers family with many similarities. The writer recalled being emotional feelings due to the 10th anniversay of JFKs death on the radio and the father pulling over to the side of road saying to never feel asahmed for crying over it as he was emotional also. The writers parents grew up in near Newport and got married in the same church as Jack and St Marys. The writer wrote about many pleasant childhood memories.
